name: Medical claim (paid by the company direct)

references.title: Employer medical benefit policy (not a statute; EA 1955 s.60F(3) pays sick-leave days, not treatment): reimbursed up to RM576 per employee per calendar year for this class. The limit is the year's remainder — 576 less the class's earlier entries of the same calendar year (`earlier.calendar_year`) — and on_exceed BLOCK pays only that remainder, so a RM400 then RM800 claim pays 400 and 176, and a third claim that year pays nothing; the excess stays on the entry for HR to see against the paid line. Encoded 2026-10-08 (QA F10).
